primary_result: At 480 training scenes, the joint controller achieved +0.035307 dB mean gain with simultaneous interval [-0.055973, +0.130342] dB; this did not resolve the +0.05 dB utility threshold, while selected-area harm was 46.6043% with interval [42.8520%, 50.3903%], above the 10% safety limit.
gate_reasons: Actionable utility was indeterminate because the simultaneous gain interval crossed zero and did not establish the +0.05 dB threshold.
Precision was unmet: the primary interval half-width was 0.095035 dB versus the frozen 0.025 dB target.
Tail safety was unsafe: selected-area harm was 46.6043%, PSNR severe-harm prevalence was 30.5%, and CVaR10 gain was -1.529606 dB.
Activation was favorable, with 12.0217% action area and 95.5% active scenes, but broad activation did not produce acceptable safety.
Target feasibility was favorable, with 149 of 150 calibration scenes effective-positive and a zero-harm oracle frontier covering approximately 25.5% to 26.6% of area.
The data-scale diagnostic was indeterminate: the paired 360-to-480 gain increment was +0.016895 dB with interval [-0.024444, +0.057976] dB.
competing_explanation: The result does not establish that dataset size alone is the limiting factor. The joint model was significantly worse than the frozen-feature control by -0.094997 dB with interval [-0.142286, -0.049863] dB, while the separate utility/risk control reduced severe harm to 2.17% and CVaR10 loss to -0.143335 dB. This more strongly supports representation or joint-objective degradation and unsafe overactivation, although the final learning-curve slope leaves additional-data benefit unresolved.
limitations: Evidence is development-screening only; confirmation, canary, and locked-test data were not touched.
The primary simultaneous interval remained substantially wider than the prespecified precision target.
The final learning-curve increment interval crossed zero, so neither continued data benefit nor structural saturation was established.
Subgroup gains were concentrated in the lowest baseline-PSNR quartile; the other three quartiles had negative mean gain.
Dominant-action flip rate across target variants was 29%, while soft-target entropy was near zero, indicating brittle supervision targets.
